name: model-runner-repeatable-oci-image-read-sessions
instr:
model-runner cannot keep one coherent image identity across configuration, layers, digests, and streams while sources change or backing resources disappear. Add context-bound read lifetimes without changing successful mutation, storage, conversion, or publication behavior.

Each `Image.OpenRead` must return either a complete context-bound `ReadSession` or an error with no partial ownership. Until `ReadSession.Close`, it must preserve one view of mutable images, Docker `BaseModel`, CNCF `CNCFModel` ModelPack images, configurable `Artifact` images, stored `Model` images, and remote images, including layer order, configuration, media semantics, DiffID relationships, and intentional accessor failures.

Isolate sessions from later mutations, wrapper creation, tag changes, unrelated store activity, and remote tag movement. A wrapper created before mutation and storage retains its original descriptors and layers. Persisted Docker and ModelPack mutations retain their prior identities and distinct format semantics.

Keep stored content readable while leased. Deletion and reset defer reclamation, preserve shared ownership, and clean up once after the final release. Uploading a stored model while its tag is deleted must finish from leased bytes without reclaiming shared blobs.

Remote sessions pin resolution and acquisition context, reuse fetched content, and return that context's cancellation cause when interrupted. Closing must be concurrent-safe and idempotent, release every resource
